name: Lambda-class T-4a shuttle
description: After producing a miltary varient of the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, as subcontracted by Raith Sienar of Sienar Fleet Systems, Cygnus Spaceworks created a non-military variant of the Lambda-class T-4a, which appears identical to the standard version aside from a few minor subtle details. With this version of the shuttle, Cygnus Spaceworks attempted to compete directly with Sienar Fleet Systems.
